author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Luka and Skari take you to the World's Faire Afterparty in the Canals of Venice in our first game of Carnevale! This game is visceral, it's got parkour, and we show you how violent drowning your opponents minis can be, and how good it feels.

-----

Explore Venice under the Rent with the Carnevale: World's Faire Afterparty two-player starter set:
